_readme: DROP-IN: example Claude Code hooks. Merge the 'hooks' block into your
(personal). Replace the placeholder commands (npx eslint / npm test etc.)
with your repo's real commands — ideally the single 'make check' named
in CLAUDE.md. Hook shapes occasionally change between Claude Code
releases; verify against current docs at
The three hooks below implement: (1) verification that always runs,
(2) a gate on 'done', (3) physics-level guards on destructive commands.

hooks._purpose: Lint/typecheck every edited file immediately. The model gets the error in-loop whether or not it would have checked. Swap in: ruff check, tsc --noEmit, etc.
Runs the test suite when Claude tries to finish. A red suite surfaces at 'done' time instead of after merge. Swap in your 'make check'.

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'push +--force|push +-f\b|reset +--hard|rm +-rf|db:migrate|migrate +(up|down|deploy)|DROP +TABLE|branch +-D' && { echo 'BLOCKED by guard hook: destructive command requires explicit human approval. Ask the user, do not retry.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
hooks._purpose: Physics-level guard on irreversible commands: force-push, hard reset, recursive delete, migrations, table drops, branch force-delete. Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and feeds the message back to Claude. Extend the pattern list for your stack (e.g., terraform apply, kubectl delete).
